movies.title: Stree 2
movies.description: The men of Chanderi are once again troubled by a supernatural entity — Sarkata, a headless ghost. Stree returns to face this new threat alongside Vicky and the gang in this hilarious horror sequel.

movies.title: Jawan
movies.description: A jail warden and his mother recruit a gang of women wronged by society to take on a ruthless businessman and the corruption that plagues the system.

movies.title: Animal
movies.description: A violent, deeply devoted son returns home to take vengeance against those who have wronged his industrialist father. A raw and unapologetic saga of love, power, and revenge.

movies.title: Fighter
movies.description: India's first aerial action film featuring Indian Air Force pilots who risk everything to defend the nation's honor in a high-stakes conflict.

movies.title: Pathaan
movies.description: An exiled spy returns to India to battle a rogue former intelligence operative who has joined forces with a mercenary group plotting a biological attack on India.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
movies.description: Pushpa Raj, the king of red sandalwood smuggling, rules the trade with an iron fist. When the government sends a determined cop and a powerful syndicate challenges his throne, Pushpa's rule faces its greatest test.

movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.description: Set in a dystopian future where mythology and science fiction merge, this epic tale follows the 10th avatar of Lord Vishnu in a world dominated by a tyrannical Supreme Yaskin.

movies.title: RRR
movies.description: A fictional story about two legendary Indian revolutionaries who fought against the British Raj and the Nizam of Hyderabad before commencing their journey of freedom struggle.

movies.title: Devara
movies.description: A fearless sea-lord terrorizes coastal criminals across generations, and his son must rise to his legacy when old enemies resurface.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.description: Deadpool is rejected by the TVA and forms an unlikely alliance with Wolverine to save the world. The duo's chaotic chemistry across the multiverse leads to an explosive adventure.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen to take his revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. He faces a choice between his love and the fate of the universe.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.description: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II — and the moral reckoning that followed.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.description: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by tyrants who now lead Rome with an iron fist.

movies.title: Inside Out 2
movies.description: Riley enters puberty and new emotions — Anxiety, Envy, Ennui — crowd the headquarters. Joy and her team must work together to restore balance in Riley's evolving mind.

movies.title: The Batman
movies.description: In Batman's second year of fighting crime, he uncovers corruption in Gotham City while pursuing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

movies.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
movies.description: Rooh Baba returns for another terrifyingly funny haunted encounter when two ancient spirits clash in Manjulika's cursed haveli.

movies.title: Leo
movies.description: A mild-mannered café owner is forced to confront his hidden violent past when gangsters come after him, unleashing a ruthless side the world never expected.

movies.title: Singham Returns
movies.description: Bajirao Singham faces a new and powerful network of criminals backed by political powers. With his cop-universe heroes, he must dismantle the most dangerous conspiracy in his career.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.description: Eddie Brock and Venom are on the run, hunted by both sides. A spectacular and emotional farewell to Marvel's lethal protector.

movies.title: Ramayana: Part 1
movies.description: The grandest retelling of the Hindu epic — Ramayana. Follow Lord Ram from Ayodhya to Lanka in a breathtaking visual spectacle of love, duty, sacrifice, and the eternal battle between good and evil.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus One
movies.description: Post-war Japan is at its lowest point when Godzilla arises. Stripped of all resources, the people of Japan must rise together against the terrifying monster.

movies.title: War 2
movies.description: The highly-anticipated sequel to War. Kabir faces off against a new enemy even more powerful than himself — a charismatic spy who has turned rogue and threatens global security.

movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD: Part 2
movies.description: The continuation of the Kalki saga. The 10th avatar of Vishnu rises to full power as the battle against Supreme Yaskin reaches its apocalyptic climax.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.description: Jake Sully and Neytiri face their greatest challenge yet as a new volcanic clan threatens the peace of Pandora. The Sully family must unite with unexpected allies to save their world.
